'''D-03-57''' was a damage report regarding the financial costs incurred by the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Morjanssik]] on [[Dac/Legends|Dac]] following a fire in the Level 12, Sector B, central shaft after a processor ignited. Equipment losses and damages totalled 15,000 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|Galactic Credit Standards]].
